task.description:
Produce design artefacts for OIDC-27 through OIDC-34 in Stream B (Stage 6.5).

Requirements to design in detail:
- OIDC-27: token verification performance target and observability envelope.
- OIDC-28: local development realm runnable setup.
- OIDC-29: realm seed as versioned artifact and drift controls.
- OIDC-30: test token issuance helper for automated suites.
- OIDC-31: end-to-end authentication test suite across real backend + IDP.
- OIDC-32: dedicated agent test identities/clients and lifecycle policy.
- OIDC-33: coexistence period behavior between legacy/API tokens and OIDC bearer path.
- OIDC-34: migration helper for transition rollout/backout safety.

For each requirement, create src/design/oidc-<NN>-<slug>.md including:
- Public function signatures + input/output types
- Data structures and persistence/seed artifact model
- Invariants and migration/coexistence safety guarantees
- API route/CLI/helper surfaces and auth scopes
- Integration test strategy and environment assumptions
- Cross-module dependencies
- Risks/open questions

Reuse and extend patterns from OIDC-20..26 design files and keep all assumptions explicit.
acceptance_criteria: All OIDC-27..34 requirements map to concrete design elements
Coexistence and migration safety semantics are explicit and testable
Realm seed/versioning strategy is deterministic and reproducible
Token helper and E2E auth suite design specify real-environment execution
Open questions are listed rather than omitted

result.summary: Designed OIDC-27 through OIDC-34 with explicit interfaces, invariants, coexistence/migration safety semantics, seed/versioning strategy, real-environment test strategy, and open questions.
